newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine agronomists expect 14.45 mln T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Argentine agronomists expect 14.45 mln T wheat.

text.p: Argentine farmers are heading to harvest 14.45 million tonnes of wheat, an agronomists association said Wednesday.
Argentina's total grain and oilseed output in 1996/97 should be 52.79 million tonnes and soybean output a record 13.58 million tonnes, according to Professional Council of Agronomists.
"The agricultural year looks favorable for the country to achieve record production superior to the much-desired 50 million tonnes, long aimed at by the government," it said.
Apart from wheat and soybeans, Argentina should produce 13.33 million tonnes of maize, 2.85 million tonnes of sorghum, and 1.8 million tonnes of other cereals, the council said.
Argentina should also produce 4.83 million tonnes of sunflower seed and 1.95 million tonnes of other oilseeds.
The council said wheat yields should average 2.14 tonnes per hectare, while maize yields should be 4.04 tonnes, soybean yields 2.18 tonnes and sunflower seed yields 1.7 tonnes.
